page.notes: Printed "Ffai." in the body is read as Esai. (long s). "multum" is doubtful (ct ligature). "niticur" may be nititur; the form is unclear. "prædītus" in the printed text is read as præditus. The paragraph number "I:" stands in the left margin and is given as a note. The top line "ut ipse Sponsi" has been read as printed.
